critique: The 2s frame now has a strong hot yellow-white core, orange flame color, and a much more compact radial explosive silhouette. It is substantially closer to an explosive Fire Trails preset than earlier versions. However, the outer streams still resolve as chunky, separated cauliflower-like fire blobs instead of thinner continuous fiery trails. The lower half remains slightly heavier and more extended than the upper burst, and the 0.08s frame is still only a small isolated ignition dot rather than a broader initial flash.

suggestions.why: Reduce auxiliary particle size so the peripheral fire reads as finer trail detail rather than large disconnected glowing blobs.
Increase auxiliary emission density to fill the gaps between smaller particles and produce more continuous flame streams.
Reduce the downward ballistic bias so the burst retains a more balanced radial explosive shape.
